change: Charge retained backing nodes once, keep one cache entry per backing tree, evict older independent trees over budget, and defer discarded cache ownership to a bounded background release worker.

fixture.contents: 100 directories with 10000 empty regular files each; measured fanout only

method.configuration: normal optimized SwiftPM Release, fresh direct xctest process for every invocation
scenarios: cache: three independent scans with different cache keys
scope: one small logical scope retained by cache
navigation: parent cached, then child scope displayed, then cache and navigation cleared in the same main-actor turn
method.ordering: each round runs cache, scope, navigation; before/after order in rounds 1 and 3, after/before in round 2
method.cache_state: warm/uncontrolled; no cache flush, builds, fixture creation, or fixture cleanup during measurement
method.after_policy: one entry per backing storage, with a single newest oversized backing tree allowed
method.options: auto-summary false; includeHiddenFiles true/false/true; treatPackagesAsDirectories false/false/true; fixture has neither hidden files nor packages
method.ownership: separate non-inlined snapshot construction frame and explicit lifetimes; no benchmark list holds snapshots
method.execution: cache/navigation mutations and all reported checkpoints on MainActor; scanner scheduling unchanged
method.after_waits: await cache.waitForPendingReleases before each cache_only_N checkpoint and before the final 100 ms settling delay; these waits are outside timed synchronous mutation calls
method.before_waits: cache destruction was synchronous inside store/removeAll, so cleanup had already completed before equivalent ownership checkpoints
method.scope: direct CompletedScanCache and WorkspaceNavigationModel measurements; final SidebarScanCacheController admission-recovery guards covered by full core tests and app build
method.units: bytes, seconds, and counts; human report uses decimal MB/GB
method.memory: all-zone malloc size_in_use, mach RSS, getrusage process peak RSS, task_vm_info footprint and reusable
method.timing: whole synchronous operations, not isolated deinitializers or SwiftUI frame durations; machine load and filesystem caches uncontrolled
method.allocator_relief: benchmark-only malloc_zone_pressure_relief(nil,0), after settling; all 18 results were zero
